# NutriGuard

> AI-powered food and allergen scanner that checks dishes for hidden allergens, breaks down nutrition, and suggests questions to ask restaurant staff.

NutriGuard helps people with dietary restrictions, allergies, or specific macro goals make safer choices when eating out or cooking at home. Users can type a dish name or upload a menu/food photo, set dietary restrictions and targets, and get an AI-generated safety scorecard with nutrition facts and a server-ready question.

- [/](/): Home — scan a dish by text or photo and view the AI safety scorecard.
